blurb: Guests can enjoy attractions including kart racing, laser tag, XD Dark Ride, bumper cars, climbing wall, mini bowling, and arcade games. The center offers party packages with reserved tables, party servers, and various play options. Food and drink options include specialty pizzas, salads, and a full-service Sky Lounge with beers on tap.
extraNote: All activities are non-transferable and valid same day as purchase
